root.name: Semi-Slav Defense: Stoltz Variation
root.moves: 1. d4 d5 2. c4 c6 3. Nc3 Nf6 4. e3 e6 5. Nf3 Nbd7 6. Qc2

overview: White plays e3, Nf3 and Qc2 against the Semi-Slav; Black develops Bd6 and castles, and White often adds b3 or g4 (Shabalov attack). Black aims for the ...e5 break. The game is a manoeuvring battle in a solid Semi-Slav structure, with sharper kingside play in the g4 branch.

white_ideas.idea: Play b3 and Bb2 or g4 to attack
Prepare e4 to open the centre

black_ideas.idea: Challenge the queen and hold d5

typical_structures.structure: Semi-Slav chain d5/c6/e6 vs White c4/d4/e3

structure.notes: Centre in tension like the QGD.

sublines_that_differ.name: Shabalov Attack
sublines_that_differ.moves: 1. d4 d5 2. c4 c6 3. Nf3 Nf6 4. Nc3 e6 5. e3 Nbd7 6. Qc2 Bd6 7. g4
sublines_that_differ.how: White attacks on the kingside; far sharper than the main line.
